{{Top|leg}}
A '''team''' at [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] designed and developed the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. Their youngest member was [[Gen Tiraan]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] from<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Chandrila">{{CSWECite|I|119|Chandrila}}</ref> When Incom was nationalised by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], several senior design staff defected to the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], taking with them designs and prototypes.<ref name="Xwing">{{CSWECite|III|345|X-wing starfighter}}</ref>
